Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for booking the intro demo. Based on the internal goals you shared (data routing requirements, on‑prem connector behavior, and latency SLOs), we think a short overview won't get to your team's core questions. Would you be open to converting the session into a targeted 90–120 minute integration lab instead — hands‑on with our engineer and a checklist for prep?

Proposed outcomes:
- Validate connector patterns for your S3/on‑prem flows
- Walk through our deployment options and network requirements
- Run a quick tokenized throughput check with a small sample dataset

If that sounds useful, proposed slots: Wed Jul 7 10:00–12:00 PT, Fri Jul 9 09:00–11:00 PT, or Tue Jul 13 13:00–15:00 PT. We can also split into 60‑minute architecture + 60‑minute hands‑on if that fits calendars better.

I attached a short POC scope template and a prework checklist (stubbed) to make the session high‑impact. If you confirm the change I’ll loop in an infra engineer and share the prework items we need (sample dataset, test account, basic network details).

Thanks — Kim
